notes: Two solid journals, their root abutments and four servo retaining clips are all part of one printed chassis solid.
Only purchased mechanical parts in this stage are the two owned servos and two MR83ZZ bearings. Moving wheels are separate prints.
The bearing outer ring is friction-fit into the wheel; its inner ring is friction-fit onto the integral printed journal. No positive axial end lock is used.
Both fits need coupons and actual pull-off/spin checks. CAD nominal diameters are starting values, not measured interference fits.
Horizontal axles require slicer supports, careful removal and fit cleanup. Avoid splitting the small journals.
Servo clip details are assumed; static clearance checks do not establish insertion force, fatigue life or physical fit.
Powered wheel and horn geometry remains an explicitly marked context envelope.
